title: Migration Request
description: Schema for a data migration request submitted to the agentic migration system. Specifies source and target connection details, tables to migrate, and migration options.

sourceType.description: Type of the source database engine.

sourceHost.description: Hostname or IP address of the source database server.

sourcePort.description: TCP port of the source database listener.

sourceDatabase.description: Source database name (Oracle SID/Service Name or SQL Server database).

sourceSchema.description: Schema within the source database to migrate from.

targetServer.description: Fully-qualified Azure SQL Database server name.

targetDatabase.description: Name of the Azure SQL Database on the target server.

targetSchema.description: Target schema in Azure SQL Database.

tables.description: List of table names to include in the migration. Use ["*"] for all tables in the source schema.

migrationMode.description: Full: truncate-and-reload. Incremental: delta-only based on watermark column.

watermarkColumn.description: Column used to detect new/changed rows (e.g. LAST_UPDATED).

lastWatermarkValue.description: ISO-8601 timestamp or numeric string of the last-synced watermark.

dryRun.description: When true, the agent generates and validates the plan but does NOT execute data movement.

requestedBy.description: Email or UPN of the person requesting the migration.

priority.description: Scheduling priority hint for the migration agent.

notifyOnCompletion.description: Additional email addresses to notify when migration completes.

tags.description: Free-form key-value tags for categorisation and cost tracking.
